purpose: The job post template, shown with one sample role (Sample role: Full-stack developer): what the role does, what you bring, how we work, pay and location, and an application form with consent. Marked as a sample throughout.

seo.title: Sample role: Full-stack developer | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: A sample job post from Alliance AI Partners: build web apps and AI tools inside partner teams in the US, Australia and the UK. Remote, Philippines. Full time.

sections.name: Hero
sections.job: Name the role, mark it as a sample, say what the job is in one sentence, and offer the one committing action, with the key facts in a strip below.
sections.desktop: Text-led: Heading/1 title (page title on a simple page), Body/LG lead 640, Primary LG + link to all roles; then a full-width facts strip (hairlines top and bottom, four cells split by hairlines): Location, Type, Pay (Data/Mono), Status.
sections.mobile: Title set on two lines (Sample role: / Full-stack developer) so it never breaks at the hyphen; lead; Primary full width LG; link; the facts strip becomes a 2 x 2 grid with hairlines.

content.heading: Sample role: Full-stack developer
content.lead: Build web apps and AI tools for partners in the US, Australia and the UK, as part of their team, and keep them running after launch.

sections.name: The role
sections.job: Say what the person will do and what they bring, with the hiring steps beside it.
sections.desktop: Article 760 (Heading/2 'What you will do' and 'What you bring', each a check list with hairlines) | sticky aside card 440 on the right: How hiring works (four numbered steps, marked sample) and a Secondary 'Apply for this role'.
sections.mobile: Both lists stack; the hiring steps follow as their own card after the lists; the Secondary button sits in the card.

content.heading: What you will do

items.text: Build web apps and AI features for partners, from the first version to launch.
Connect partner tools to AI assistants and to automation platforms such as Make, n8n and Zapier.
Work inside the partner’s team: their tools, their stand-ups and their standards.
Keep what you built running after launch, and improve it over time.
Write down how it works, clearly enough for a new hire to follow.

body: Experience building and running web apps that real customers use, front end and back end.
Good judgment with AI coding tools: you use them for the repetitive work and check what they write.
Clear written English. Partners read what you write every week.
Care with data. Partner data stays where the partner decides.
Nice to have: Next.js, TypeScript, or experience connecting tools to AI assistants.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Your links and a short note.

items.title: First call
items.text: A [30-minute] call about your work and ours.

items.title: Work sample
items.text: A short task, reviewed by the people you would work with.

items.title: Offer
items.text: A decision within [one week], either way.

sections.name: How we work
sections.job: Show the ways of working that apply to every role.
sections.desktop: Navy chapter. Heading/1 head, then a two-column check list (three rows each) with hairlines and Ribbon Cyan checks.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; one column of six check rows.

content.heading: How we work.
content.lead: The same ways of working on every project, whatever the role.

items.text: You work inside the partner’s team, in their tools and to their standards.
A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches a partner.
We try new AI tools on our own business first, and keep only what proves itself.
Everything is written down, clearly enough for a new hire to follow.
If AI isn’t the right answer, we say so. Bad news goes out early, with a plan to fix it.

sections.name: Apply
sections.job: Take the application (name, email, links, message, consent), clearly marked as a sample form.
sections.desktop: Split: text column 560 (Heading/2, Body/LG lead, Info alert marking the sample) | white form card (name and email side by side, links, message, consent, Primary LG).
sections.mobile: Title, lead, alert, then the form card at full width; Primary full width LG.

content.heading: Apply for this role.
content.lead: Send your links and a short note. We reply to every application within [one week].
body: This is a sample role. The form shows how applying will work; it doesn’t send anything until real roles open.
Read how we handle your details in our privacy notice.

fields.label: Tell us about something you built
fields.placeholder: What it does, who uses it, and what you did.

fields.label: I agree that Alliance AI Partners may keep my application to consider me for this role.

notes: Template for every job post, shown with one sample role. The sample is marked in the title ('Sample role:'), in the facts strip (Status: Sample role, not open), on the hiring steps ('Sample process') and by an Info alert beside the form. Pay stays [salary range]; the hiring times stay [30-minute] and [one week] (owner check). Location 'Remote, Philippines' and 'Full time' belong to the sample role only. Duties and ways of working come from the Brand DNA (services list: AI software engineering, Make, n8n and Zapier automation, AI connectors; values; review and weekly-progress commitments). 'Nice to have' tools are part of the sample. No images: a simple page. One Primary in the hero and one on the form (desktop y 329 and 3087; mobile 344 and 4145); the aside apply button is Secondary. Header marks About as current. Lint clean on both frames; no overflow on mobile.
